finalists.why: It has the most specific findings, including a well-circumscribed lesion and heterogeneous enhancement.

finalists.label: Sarcoma
finalists.why: It has the most comprehensive set of findings, including low signal intensity on T1-weighted images, high signal intensity on T2-weighted images, and fluorodeoxyglucose avidity.

frontier_selector.why: Sarcoma is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including the mass's heterogeneous enhancement and fluorodeoxyglucose avidity.

support_spans: Lumbar MRI revealed a well-circumscribed 5 cm lesion in the left retroperitoneal space, adjacent to the iliopsoas muscle, with low signal intensity on T1-weighted images and high signal intensity on T2-weighted images
a 52×47 mm mass anterior to L4, abutting the left ureter and left common iliac artery, with heterogeneous enhancement
the mass demonstrated fluorodeoxyglucose avidity with an SUVmax of 5.2
contradict_spans: Brain and chest CT scans were normal
